reference.title: Effects of regular consumption of grapefruit juice on the pharmacokinetics of simvastatin.
reference.abstract: Even one glass of grapefruit juice, taken daily, considerably increases the plasma concentrations of simvastatin and simvastatin acid. Grapefruit juice may increase both the cholesterol-lowering effect and the risk of adverse effects of simvastatin.
